the lay of the green

to the pin as possible.

your swing. Hold 

sure to read the
wind direction.

Watch your trainer's
mitts, and try to hit
them. You lose points
if you hit your trainer.

Your trainer throws
ball after ball at you.
Move left and right
to avoid getting hit.

Throw punches at
the punching bags
until you knock them
off their chains.
Well-aimed combo
punches are key.

Knock down the pins
with a single throw.
Twist your wrist to
curve the ball.

Avoid the barriers in
the lane and knock
down the pin. You'll
have to balance speed
and spin.

Knock down as many
pins as you can. A
new row will be added
after each set. Strikes
double your score!
